dose_calibration.note: per-mother calibration of the preregistered drift prediction; epsilon = a1 - J_pre with clone-level standard errors replaces the ratio as the primary bias measure
dose_calibration.prediction: a_1(shifted by v) ~= J_pre(shifted state); long-horizon q_B decreases directionally
dose_calibration.ratio_threshold: |J_pre| >= 1; ratios near zero-predicted mothers are unstable

SOURCE.definition: training pooled clone-level group mean per source group; no descriptors, no held-out fitting

heldout.note: ridge logistic lambda=1 standardized, unpenalised intercept, fit on training mothers only; AUC ranks the thresholded labels q_B>0.5; mse_qB is the MSE against per-mother clone-level q_B estimates, so it carries branch-level binomial noise shared by all models and paired differences remain meaningful; SOURCE baseline uses training pooled group means only

interpretation: confirmatory screening: pre-registered displacement directions, total-matched structure decomposition and held-out nested model comparison; no causal or infinite-time claims
